title: Large personal Amiga/CPC/ST/DOS engine and media recovery discovery
summary: Personally screen 785 candidate URLs and add 16 projects, with eight explicit non-promotion decisions.
notes: Root personally searched 12 GitHub query routes, screened 785 unique URLs and inspected 24 pinned repository trees. Sixteen additions and eight explicit non-promotions. Original-source platform is distinguished from modern port targets, free speech tables from original voice fidelity, and semantic source restoration from mechanical CPU recompilation. No upstream game, compiler, installer, emulator or hardware program executed.

sources.reason: Upstream reports all 2,297 game functions/580,076 game-code bytes matched, with separate 113-module XnGine assembly rebuild and readable engine C. Inspected structured collision geometry and exact arithmetic.
Function-level Watcom DOS4GW translation to structured C99 with original address citations, graphics scaling and sound routines. Inspected game logic from original 0x10B98-0x129A6 range.
Function-by-function recovery of TP6 game and PaxiMod player with source-offset-annotated C and original global semantics. Inspected game state and 70 Hz retrace timing.
Original-address-cited game core preserves RNG, wall/floor rules, scoring and 187 Hz timing. Inspected tick/key queue and arithmetic.
BL2.OVL-derived deterministic rules, demo AI, RNG and rotation timing; inspected source-routine-cited keyboard/game state.
Deterministic Rust game core using Lemmix behavior and Lemmings.ts data parsing references. Inspected bashing masks, object-map steel and directional constraints.
Structured game routines recovered from Borland executable and 12 code overlays inside data archive. Inspected explicit game-flow functions with native yield/interrupt scheduling.
Reconstructs translator.library and narrator.device 33.2 pipeline; inspected original hunk-cited contour markers and formant-stage semantics. Returns signed 8-bit Paula-style samples and period.
Browser converter recovers classic word-processor text/control formatting into HTML, including unofficial special-character variant. Inspected actual FileReader and conversion implementation.
Independent ANSI-C archive service/CLI reconstructs classic LhA 2.15 behavior and level 0–2 headers. Inspected extension-chain/header handling and Amiga path normalization.
Structured simulation follows original 16-bit cell/state encoding and scan/dispatch order; inspected RNG and board loop. Original files read as data, software rendering and DOSBox OPL audio.
Modern native Jedi Engine reconstruction supporting Dark Forces and original mods, with recovered archive/game systems. Inspected actual GOB directory handling.
Structured function-level race simulation over original memory records and EGA model. Inspected source-cited race helpers, arithmetic and explicit stale-stack approximations.
Historical measured SON format decoder reconstructs track/event interpretation and emits MIDI. Inspected actual six-byte note/velocity/position conversion.
Prototype-target matching decompilation with structured play, menus, video and original data arrays; inspected substantial play.c implementation.
Classic 1982 game reconstructed into structured C++ with original RNG and platform-specific console/SDL adapters. Inspected state and random generation.

Legacy and modern stub trees contain partial reconstruction but renderer, sound, IPX, shape editor and starfield remain missing. Current launcher baseline is not a direct recovered game; qualify source evidence before promotion.
Every x86 instruction mechanically becomes C over a machine-state layer. Native compilation is not recovered high-level game logic; preserve recompilation audit.
Recovered source is Windows 3.x Jewel Thief. DOS is a new target port, not original source platform; keep for Windows-source discovery.
Modernizes a 2003/2004 KDE/Qt application rather than historical Amiga/ST/CPC/DOS source; retro terminal character sets do not change origin.
Playable path wraps m2c-decompiled VM; native v2 mirror is still being grown and audio executes original 8086 driver. Do not promote as completed semantic replacement.
SDL compatibility layer for FreeDOS with packaged ports; tooling/target-host work, not an independently reconstructed historical game/application.
README explicitly says setup integrated into tracked skynettx/raptor since 2025-10-02. Avoid separate stale project entry.
Active reconstruction targets Windows IGN_WIN.EXE; DOS work is superseded secondary reference. One-routine harness and broad goals are not completed DOS engine recovery.
